decision_cruda.rationale: Norte lost LH-01 and LH-02 (repairs likely 13:30/14:30). Norte has 3 trucks at 66 t/h and a 242 t stockpile. LH-03 inflow is 36 t/h, so the stockpile drains at about 30 t/h and lasts roughly 8 h. Trucks therefore run near full until 17:00 (about 495 t hauled vs about 512 t available) without a loan. An extra loader such as LH-08 (0.65 h travel, about 25 t/h) would add almost no hauled ounces, because the trucks are the limit. It would cost about 0.2 oz/h of development value, about 1.4 oz. Central is already truck-limited (96 vs 91 t/h). Este is the only mine with truck room, but its only possible lender is the critical-path heading at 4 oz/h. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00 and is not a valid lender. A loan therefore doesn't pay, so I'm making no moves.
